applies_why: This judge text decides whether verses pressed against D2 vs C3 count as unanswered witnesses, so K-G4 governs it.
quote: the line is cured by retraction, not defended: every witness pressed against C3 was named and answered in the challenger's own later rounds ((DR2) §C and (DR3) C3 quoting Matthew 1:18, 1:25 and Deuteronomy 22:24; (DR3) C4 quoting Luke 1:34), so the "witness left unanswered" ground fails and the collision is regraded UNDERDETERMINED
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge's ground is that the witnesses were answered, and it therefore removes the broken-link/unanswered-witness ground rather than counting those verses, so it obeys K-G4's answered-verse prohibition.
